tasks.label: Prepare Android API
tasks.command: adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000; if (-not (Test-Path env:SKIP_API_CHECK)) { try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; Write-Host 'API ok on :3000' } catch { Write-Host 'WARNING: backend not running. In a terminal: cd backend && npm start' } }
